sources.title: Automerge Text
source_statements: Collaborative string edits use splice; the example merges concurrent insert and replacement/deletion.
Whole-string updateText derives splices; large intervals between updates may merge poorly.
conditions_exceptions: Docs recommend frequent updateText calls; this is not a measured guarantee for another adapter.
sources.applicability_inference: Supports an offline sequence-CRDT candidate; choose operation granularity deliberately.
proposed_checks: Compare splice and whole-string adapter traces for concurrent insert/delete.

sources.title: Automerge Conflicts
source_statements: Concurrent text sequence insertions/deletions are preserved; equal-position inserts receive consistent order.
Concurrent same-property/index writes expose a deterministic value while retaining other conflict values for inspection.
conditions_exceptions: Scalar/index conflict behavior differs from sequence text behavior; LWW order uses operation IDs, not wall-clock timestamps.
sources.applicability_inference: Use sequence operations for text and separately define whether users should see or resolve conflicts.
proposed_checks: Run both merge directions for a same-anchor insert and delete trace.

sources.title: Automerge Concepts
sources.locator: Documents, Repositories, Sync Protocol, Storage Format; lines 67-77, 91-97
source_statements: Documents retain commit-like change history; repositories combine local storage and peer synchronization.
The compact binary format can store edit history; repository compression accounts for concurrent reads and writes.
conditions_exceptions: No byte ceiling, deletion-retention window, or product-specific pruning guarantee is stated.
sources.applicability_inference: History aids inspectability but retained bytes need a product-scale measurement.
proposed_checks: Measure persisted bytes for a 20 KB note under repeated edits/deletions and compaction.

sources.title: Yjs Document Updates
source_statements: Updates are commutative, associative and idempotent; state vectors can select missing differences.
Merging update blobs removes duplicate information but does not garbage-collect deleted content; load a Y.Doc to reduce size.
conditions_exceptions: The update-only route does not perform deletion cleanup.
sources.applicability_inference: A second inspectable sequence-CRDT implementation with an explicit retained-deletion caveat.
proposed_checks: Measure bytes before and after loading/compacting a document with deletions.

sources.title: ShareDB Introduction
source_statements: A server coordinates/commits edits; conflict management uses OT type plugins; offline change syncing and historic versions are listed.
conditions_exceptions: No pending-operation queue limit or undo contract is stated.
sources.applicability_inference: Central relay plus OT merits a bounded stale-client reconnect test.
proposed_checks: Reconnect after a long offline interval with deletes, inserts, and undo.

sources.title: ShareDB OT Types
source_statements: ShareDB delegates transformation to OT types; json0 is the default; additional types must be registered on client and server.
conditions_exceptions: The page does not establish that the example rich-text type is the desired plain-text type.
sources.applicability_inference: Treat a text-compatible transform as an explicit dependency and product decision.
proposed_checks: Select and test a plain-text OT type under stale operation rebasing.
